<section class="cs-hero">
  <div style="max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;">
    <h1>Service Gap Intelligence</h1>
    <p>Which medicines and priority services are stocked where &mdash; outlet-level availability for malaria commodities, antimicrobials, and other priority medicines.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="cs-wrap">
  <span class="cs-badge">Coming soon</span>
  <h2>What this layer will show</h2>
  <p>The accreditation records used in the <a href="registry.html">CPP Registry</a> tell us <em>where</em> outlets exist. Service Gap Intelligence will layer on <em>what medicines each outlet actually stocks</em>, drawn from stock-availability surveys and supervisory visit records.</p>

  <ul class="cs-list">
    <li>Malaria commodities: RDT availability, ACT stock by first-line regimen (AL, ASAQ), quality of stored medicines.</li>
    <li>Antimicrobials: presence of Access, Watch and Reserve categories, over-the-counter dispensing patterns.</li>
    <li>Reproductive, maternal and child health medicines: iron-folate, ORS+zinc, family-planning commodities.</li>
    <li>Service deserts: wards and districts where accredited outlets exist but priority commodities are chronically absent.</li>
  </ul>

  <div class="cs-cta">
    <strong>Data we are looking for:</strong> if you have a validated CPP stock-availability dataset for Tanzania (LMIS, supervisory reports, retail audits), we would love to hear from you. Please write to us via the <a href="help.html">Help</a> page.
  </div>
</div>
